images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — SCENE PLATE for an in-scene register test. An interior: the Keepers' archive hall — a worn grey flagstone floor filling most of the frame, a low stone plinth with stacked ledgers and a brass hour-glass at the upper-left, a dark wooden shelf of scroll-tubes along the far wall at the top edge, a few fallen pages and a coil of rope on the floor, deep shadowed alcoves. Elevated three-quarter camera (projection C, the ARPG camera): the floor is the play surface and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, the far wall the upper third; NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Register: FLAT INK-AND-WASH 2D — clean uniform ink outline, flat colour fills with at most one wash of shadow, no painted texture, no gradients, muted palette, graphic and minimal; a frame of hand-drawn cel animation. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black; no spell glow. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette.

concerns: Followed the task's verbatim scene prompt, which conflicts with the frozen register's green plate, sheet dimensions, and painted style.
Generated surfaces show subtle texture and tonal gradients despite the prompt's flat-fill constraints.
